guard: no suite may read the ambient environment through configFromEnv/controlFromEnv/hasIdentity without a module-scope COTAL_ prefix scrub before that first read
why: Issue #833. The sibling census smoke:suite-ambient-env grades the environment a suite hands a
CHILD. Nothing graded a suite that reads its OWN process environment. Whatever runs a suite may
be a managed agent session, so such a read is handed a live identity nobody chose: the connector
config layer refuses the two-carrier launch and the suite dies inside its own import, with an
error that reads exactly like a code defect in the thing under test. CI carries none of those
variables, so CI never saw it.
N1 removes the scrub from the suite #833 names by file. It must redden that file's per-file
cell, which is the census's only real output for a missing scrub.
N2 is ORDER, not presence. A scrub below the read is still a scrub to any check that only asks
whether the line exists, and the live refusal still fires. The cell naming 'before its first
ambient read' is the one that has to go red.
N3 is the census shrinking silently. Every per-file cell is generated from the census, so
walking one package deletes cells rather than failing them, and a suite with fewer cells still
exits 0. The package-span cell is what makes that red.
N4 is the distinction the brief of this census turns on: a scrub written inside a function is a
promise that the function runs before every read, and source cannot see whether it does.
Accepting a scrub at any depth must redden the uncalled-function fixture.
N5 is the narrow scrub. Deleting the single variable that throws today leaves the twelve beside
it, so recognising a named delete as a prefix scrub must redden the single-variable fixture.
NO BUILD STEP: the suite reads source files off disk and imports nothing from a built package,
so there is no dist/ copy that could disagree with the mutation.

mutations.find:
for (const key of Object.keys(process.env)) if (key.startsWith("COTAL_")) delete process.env[key];

process.env.COTAL_SPACE ||= "toolclosed";

mutations.note: The exact file issue #833 names. Without the scrub, running it from inside a connected session dies in its own import on the one-identity-plane refusal.
